name: CorpFlowAI — Business Operations Monitor v1 (TEMPLATE, INACTIVE, SECRET-FREE)

meta.note: Stage 1 template. NO CREDENTIALS, NO TOKENS, NO CHAT IDS. Set CORPFLOW_MONITOR_BASE_URL, CORPFLOW_CRON_SECRET, TELEGRAM_* in n8n env store before activating (Stage 2, Anton-gated).

parameters.content:
## Business Operations Monitor v1

**Inactive by design.** Activation is Anton-gated.

Before activating, IN n8n ONLY:
1. `CORPFLOW_MONITOR_BASE_URL` → e.g. `https://core.corpflowai.com`
2. `CORPFLOW_CRON_SECRET` → same as Vercel Production cron secret
3. `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` + `TELEGRAM_ALERT_CHAT_ID` → existing ops alert path
4. Optional ERPNext sandbox ping: enable the disabled ERPNext node + set `ERPNEXT_MONITOR_URL` / `ERPNEXT_API_KEY` in n8n only

Polls `GET /api/factory/business-operations-monitor` (read-only).
**Exception-only:** Telegram on `severity=urgent` only; silent on warnings and green runs (issue #658).
